Improvements

notes.title: Graveport City, Guns & Ammo Update - v0.7.5.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995362/95e0b818505b18baaa7d1f8ea045a14ea02001a2.png

Features

 Add Bandit camp in Graveport City
 Add lootables all around Graveport City
 Add 1 hour time limit to Prologue
 Added Gun Powder
 Added Bullet Casings
 Added ability to craft Ballistic ammo using Gun Powder and Bullet Casings
 Added Weapons Workbench where you can craft Ammo and Weapons


Improvements

 Vehicle automatically goes to 3rd person now (you can still switch back if you want)
 Increased Luma Capsule light range
 Added build version to UI
 Increase base walk speed for Zombies
 Added extra XP if you clear a Bandit camp
 Updated lootable object so it can have more variation (ie. the same vehicle can have different colors, paint deterioration, etc)
 Added more knives around Zector 3 facility to help player find a weapon
 Replaced Electronics icon and mesh
 Replaced String icon and mesh
 Replace Medpack icon and mesh
 Adjusted Axe and Pickaxe damage for resources and enemies
 Updated descriptions of Ballistic weapons and Ammo so it's more obvious which weapons an ammo will work with
 Increased durability of Machete
 Add more variety to ammo drops from Zombies
 Add marker to Metal Scrap mission so it's more obvious where the crashed ship is
 Increased credits dropped by Bandits to a minimum of 5 (when they drop them)
 Increased punch damage


Bug fixes

 Fixed host player not being able to exit vehicle
 Changed Exit Vehicle key back to E
 Fixed client players not being able to exit vehicle
 Fixed Beacon Tower loot crate from freezing the game
 Fixed Inventory item description auto-sizing description
 Fixed vehicle UI from staying on screen after exiting vehicle
 Fixed Photon Fury Rifle scope
 Fixed Camp Hope Trader Joe shack from being able to take damage (as well as other items in Camp Hope)
 Fixed Cupboard in Camp Hope so it's not interactable anymore
 Fixed dead zombies from looking alive on client in multiplayer
 Fixed not being able to interact with things under water
 Fixed not being able to drink from water in certain areas
 Fixed river from blocking bullets/projectiles
 Fixed bugs missing from Zector 3 facility
 Fixed not being able to repair a lot of items at Repair Bench
 Fixed Beacon Tower from disappearing after activation
 Fixed Bandits from team-firing at the same camp
 Fixed lighting for certain items in Zector facilities
 Fixed furniture not being visible in certain areas
 Fixed Vendor Sell Lists so they don't disappear when you sell something
 Fixed hats from removing beards

notes.title: Sell, Sell, Sell - Update v0.7.4
notes.notes:
Features

 Add sell price for items to Inventory UI


Improvements

 Increase melee hit distance of Knife and Machete to 120 and 150 from 60 and 90
 Changed nails recipe to craft 16 nails instead of 8
 Changed foundation to be the only build piece that requires nails
 Reduce bug meat cook time (and all others) to 0.5 sec
 Changed Walls, Floors, Roofs and Foundations to craft 2 instead of 1
 Added Change Perspective control to HUB input list
 Add Weapon Attachments control to HUB input list
 Increase shotgun drop percentage on Zombies
 Increase molotov fire range by 2x
 Add more crashed ships (to find metal scrap) near the first tower and around the map
 Increased Bow stone and metal arrows damage to 2x what they were so it should only take a couple shots to kill zombies and humans.
 Reduce campfire's temperature increase from 7 to 3.
 Added shop to Medic Joshua so you can buy medical supplies from him.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed molotov and grenade explosion mechanic
 Fixed Video settings UI
 Fixed 2nd player in vehicle camera height
 Fixed Repair UI
 Fixed Vendor UI so it now shows the sell list

notes.title: Zector 7 - Bugfix Update v0.7.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995362/217993760397480ca07339b62362fc7d11aa95bf.png
Features

 Added Machine Gun Turrets that activate once a Beacon Tower is activated, which will defend player from enemies


Improvements

 Added icon and mesh for Raw Bug Meat and Cooked Bug Meat
 Added Cooked Bug Meat Recipe to Campfire
 Increased Days from 24 to 36. Nights remain at 12
 Added more ammo to dead body area outside of Zector 3
 Increased spawn rate for Tech Rifle in Tech Weapon Crate
 Added better loot in Captains Quarters in Zector 3
 Changed Interaction Text on Kitchen and Water fountain wall parts to "Use" instead of "Search" so it's more obvious they are interactable
 Changed wording for Cupboard and Beacon so it's more understandable what they do
 Added more torque/speed to Tech Truck and made it All-Wheel Drive


Bugfixes

 Fixed not being able to exit vehicle (Use E to exit now)
 Added Cooked Bug Meat Recipe to Campfire
 Fixed Video Settings not applying and saving
 Fixed Customization screen showing no light on skin shader
 Fixed Valley Navmesh that was preventing AI from walking around
 Removed duplicate "toggle map" input instructions
 Added auto-wrapping to Mission title box
 Moved Ammo crate in Captains Quarters so it's interactable

notes.title: Zector 7: Sci-Fi Demo Update - Playtest 0.7.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995362/217993760397480ca07339b62362fc7d11aa95bf.png

Features

 Add entirely new Settings UI
 Added new Audio Settings (including a slider for music and weather effects)
 Added cruiser ship above Graveport City
 Added Rocket launchpad with rocket and helipad next to it
 Added more land vehicles to the map (4x4 Zector truck & buggy)
 Added gas cans (to fill up vehicles)
 Added gas tank to fill up gas cans
 Added bandits around the map that will fight players, each other, or zombies
 Added planetary cannon to the map


Improvements

 Reworked the loot tables so enemies and loot containers dropped more interesting items
 Lowered Thunder volume by 50%
 Added a new Rain Weather without thunder so thunder is less frequent
 Reduced Thunder in Thunderstorm to be less frequent
 Balanced the boar and chicken health alongside the damage output of weapons so it feels a lot better. Boards and chickens die with 2 arrows, 1 bullet from any gun, but zombies take 2-3 depending on if you can headshot them
 Reduced knife and machete swing speed
 Increased zombies walk speed
 Disabled minimap by default
 Increased zoom on minimap
 Reworked the landscape so it's easier to see Graveport City from afar
 Populated the snowy mountain biome with foliage and a mountain


Bug Fixes

 Fixed not being able to exit a vehicle
 Fixed farm house spawning in wrong location
 Fixed Inventory not closing when pressing Tab
 Fixed Settings UI not closing properly
 Fixed minimap and big map textures
 Fixed AI not dropping items sometimes including boar not dropping meat
 Fixed zombies that were supposed to be running, but were walking
 Fixed missions that were allowing players to continually complete them
 Fixed missions that weren't automatically starting the next mission

notes.title: Zector 7: Secrets of Zector 1 Update - Playtest v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
Features

 Added Towers around the map with beacons so it's easy to see where you should go
 Changed starting location to be in a brand new futuristic science laboratory known as Zector 1. 
 Added missions to help get you started and escape Zector 1 facility.
 Added enemies within Zector 1
 Added Vending Machine so you can spend your hard-earned credits on fancy loot
 Added Luma Capsule, a small holdable & throwable capsule that lights up the surrounding area in a neon glow
 Added Beacon placement building that helps you identify your base and doubles as a "Cupboard", which allows you to stake a claim of a certain area, preventing others from building there.
 Added more ponds and lakes to make it easier to find drinkable water
 Added more lootable cars and houses around the map
 Added futuristic lootable vehicles
 Added tiered loot system so you can get more common loot from things like enemies and cars and more rare items in places you'd expect to find them. It also spawns random items within that tier so different playthroughs will get different items.
 Added Automated Door system with locking/unlocking via Computer Panels, which enables some interesting mechanics in the Zector facilities.
 Redesigned almost every UI screen to have new fonts, colors and animations.
 Added Feedback form so players can leave in-game feedback easily by hitting F12 or selecting it in the Pause Menu
 Added Controls screen to easily see Input Controls in the Pause Menu
 Added basic Controller support to player movement (UI still requires a mouse)


Improvements

 Changed main currency to be called Credits and look like Coins. Cash is now Old World Money and is worth very little.
 Added title of Crafting station you are interacting with to UI (ie. Workbench now says "Workbench" instead of "Crafting")
 Updated Thirst & Hunger to go down 75% slower
 Increased Stamina regen by 100%
 Reduced amount of stamina certain actions like punching cost
 Added better SFX for campfire
 Fence wall recipe in Workbench now crafts 4 Fence Walls for the same cost
 Fence Walls now stack up to 20
 Added same water component to rivers that lakes/ponds have, which allows SFX and VFX when interacting with water. (Still working on making them drinkable)
 Made the pond in the starter area easier to find
 Removed metal scrap from Repair Bench recipe so it's easier to craft
 Added more crashed ships and metal barrels around the map so it's easier to find Metal Scrap
 Added a lot of UI text to Localization to make it easier to Localize in the future.
 Started adding unique Names to items with interesting descriptions to give the game more character.
 Reduced Take All button SFX
 Reduced Torch brightness by 50%
 Added Inventory controls to UI when inventory is open
 Removed all starter weapons from player on respawn
 Added lake at the bottom of the river in the mountain biome
 Increased Wood stack to 20


Bug Fixes

 Fixed campfire interact text
 Fixed Fence wall icon
 Fixed issue with Cupboard not crafting
 Fixed some trees not having collisions
 Fixed eating playing drinking SFX
 Fixed bandages SFX so they have their own unique sound now
 Fixed "Strange Signal" mission so now you can complete it by going to the marker.
 Fixed issue with View Sensitivity in Pause Menu
 Fixed "Craft a Workbench" mission
 Fixed Ammo type bug that made it so you couldn't reload certain weapons
 Fixed container bug that was duplicating items for clients
 Fixed AI Spawner issue that was spawning a lot more enemies than it was supposed to
 Removed Gate that was duplicating from another part of the map
 Fixed Survivor Skill tree that prevented player from unlocking past 3
 Fixed Audio issues where audio was only playing on Host and not Client
 Fixed bow not reloading on clients



If you want to join up with others or leave feedback, you can join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/t7ZYSXvXCE
